name: billboard-platform
description: Billboard backend: API contracts, Lambda services, CDK infrastructure and the share site. Each package keeps its own lockfile; see README.md.

scripts.setup: cd contracts && env -u npm_config_allow_scripts npm ci && cd ../services && env -u npm_config_allow_scripts npm ci && cd ../infra && env -u npm_config_allow_scripts npm ci
scripts.check: cd contracts && npm run check --silent && cd .. && bash scripts/ci/check-layout.sh && node --check website/app.js && node scripts/ci/check-website-chrome.mjs && node scripts/ci/test-website-app.mjs
scripts.typecheck: cd services && npm run typecheck && cd ../infra && npm run typecheck
scripts.lint: cd services && npm run lint --silent && npm run format:check --silent
scripts.test: cd services && npm test --silent -- --ci --coverage && cd ../infra && npm test -- --ci
scripts.release:synth: cd infra && BILLBOARD_STRICT_RELEASE=true BILLBOARD_RELEASE_MANIFEST_FILE=../.release/manifest.json BILLBOARD_RELEASE_ID=$(cat ../.release/release-id) npx cdk synth --quiet --no-lookups --no-notices -o ../.release/cdk.out
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run synth && npm run release:build && npm run release:synth
